english.note: This is the all-purpose Hong Kong Cantonese word for a sofa or couch.
This is the all-purpose everyday word for an upholstered sofa.

examples.english: This couch is really comfortable, and three people can sit on it without feeling cramped.
examples.traditional: 呢張梳化好舒服，坐三個人都唔迫。
examples.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 so1 faa3 hou2 syu1 fuk6 zo6 saam1 go3 jan4 dou1 m4 bik1

examples.english: The sofa is really comfortable to sit on.
